C1.name: User
responsibilities: abstract base of all users; SINGLE_TABLE 'users' with discriminator column 'role'

C2.name: Citizen
responsibilities: user subtype with discriminator value CITIZEN

C3.name: MunicipalOperator
responsibilities: user subtype with discriminator value MUNICIPAL_OPERATOR

C4.name: Credentials
responsibilities: embedded e-mail (unique) and password stored in the users table

C5.name: Location
responsibilities: embedded address of a report stored in the reports table

C6.name: Report
responsibilities: root record of a municipal report with its current status name and editability flag

C7.name: InternalNote
responsibilities: operator-only note attached to a report

C8.name: StatusUpdate
responsibilities: history record of a status change made by an operator

C9.name: Notification
responsibilities: message sent to the reporting citizen about a notifiable status

C10.name: ReportCategory
responsibilities: closed set of report categories, persisted by name in reports.category

C32.name: Report
responsibilities: persists current status as the string column current_status (submitted, assigned, in_progress, resolved); ReportStatus object is @Transient

C33.name: StatusUpdate
responsibilities: one row per status transition, written by Report.updateStatus with timestamp, new status and operator

C34.name: Notification
responsibilities: only the statuses assigned and resolved may be notified; created by ReportService.generateStatusChangeNotification

C35.name: Report
responsibilities: created in status submitted with citizen_editable true; the operator is assigned on the first status update

C36.name: reports_db
responsibilities: MySQL database reached through the Hibernate persistence unit Municipal_Report_Management_System; schema created with hbm2ddl.auto=update

C37.name: municipal-report-management.jar
responsibilities: Maven build unit

C38.name: JpaUtil
responsibilities: creates the EntityManagerFactory for persistence unit Municipal_Report_Management_System and hands out EntityManagers

C39.name: PersistenceService
responsibilities: saves, updates and queries any entity in its own transaction (save, update, findById, findByAttribute, findByFields)

C40.name: UserService
responsibilities: registers users and looks them up by credentials; checks whether an id is a Citizen or a MunicipalOperator

C41.name: ReportService
responsibilities: creates reports, reads reports, details and history, updates status, adds internal notes, generates notifications and monitoring results

C42.name: UserRegistrationController
responsibilities: registers a new user through UserService

C43.name: UserLoginController
responsibilities: retrieves user data by credentials through UserService

C44.name: ReportCreationController
responsibilities: registers a new report for a citizen

C45.name: ReportReviewController
responsibilities: retrieves submitted reports for a citizen and received reports for an operator

C46.name: ReportDetailsController
responsibilities: retrieves report details and status history

C47.name: ReportStatusUpdateController
responsibilities: advances the report status and requests a notification

C48.name: NotificationController
responsibilities: checks whether the new status is notifiable and sends the notification

C49.name: InternalNoteController
responsibilities: registers an internal note for an operator

C50.name: ActivityMonitoringController
responsibilities: produces monitoring results over stored reports

C90.label: JPQL built by string concatenation from attribute names
